title: EQLMaker {0} - setup inside the package folder
usage:
Usage: eqlmaker-setup.cmd [options]
  -offline        no network access; uses the archives that are in downloads\
  -lang en|de     language of the messages (default: language of Windows)
  -model <name>   download a larger speech recognition model and make it the default
                  (base, small-q5_1, small, medium-q5_0, large-v3-turbo-q5_0, large-v3-turbo-q8_0)
  -no-postgres    do not install the portable PostgreSQL (you use your own server)
  -postgres <b>   build of the portable PostgreSQL: mingw (default) or edb
  -with-psql      also install psql with the MinGW build (fetches two GPL libraries)
  -no-selftest    do not run the self test at the end
  -unattended     no questions, no pause; exit code 0 ready, 1 failed, 2 self test failed,
                  3 offline and files are missing
  -help           this text
